tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: The public site's page ground (bg-cream, set on body in globals.css and on the public layout). Feels like a printed record sleeve; the paper-grain overlay sits on it. Text on it: ink, oxblood, forest, ink-80 to ink-65.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Two jobs. As a ground: the studio world (artist portal, admin, bar till, gamer portal), the public footer, the home hero and inner-page banners. As text: body copy on cream (13.9:1) and on bone (15.4:1), the label on ochre buttons (5.7:1), and the label of any oxblood or bone button once it hovers to ochre (5.7:1). Never pure black.

tokens.name: bone
tokens.usage: Two jobs. As text: headings and primary text on ink (15.4:1), on oxblood (7.3:1) and on forest (6.6:1). As a ground: form inputs on the public site and the light button on the oxblood band. Never pure white.

tokens.name: oxblood
tokens.usage: The flame. Headlines and section titles on cream (6.7:1), the short rule under every section title, primary buttons with bone text (7.3:1), the closing 'Sign with One Flame' band, album pills, the footer's top border, and the 2px focus outline round every field on the public site (6.7:1 on cream, 7.3:1 on a bone field, 8.6:1 on a white one). Too dark as text or icons on ink (2.1:1) and on the lounge grounds (about 2.3:1); use rose there. The Lounge pillar icons and menu category labels moved to rose on 2026-10-05.

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: The inner flame. Small uppercase eyebrows on cream (6.0:1), EP pills with bone text (6.6:1). FAILS on ink (2.3:1), on the lounge grounds (about 2.5:1) and over the hero photo. SectionHeader switched to sage on dark grounds on 2026-10-05, but forest is still used for the eyebrows of the home hero, the ink banners that open inner public pages (artists, releases, videos, news, sign, privacy, terms) and the Lounge sections; use sage on dark grounds in new work.

tokens.name: ochre
tokens.usage: The call to action. Solid ochre buttons with ink text (5.7:1), single pills, 'new' badges, money figures and accent text on ink (5.7:1) and lounge grounds (6.1 to 6.4:1), link hover, and the 2px focus outline round every field on ink (5.7:1; 5.1:1 on a bone-5 card). FAILS as text on cream (2.4:1) — the public site uses it there only as a link hover colour; keep it off cream for anything that must be read. When a button hovers to ochre its text turns ink (5.7:1); bone text on ochre is only 2.7:1, so never leave it there.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Oxblood lifted for dark grounds (globals.css). Error and 'scheduled'/'failed' text and links on ink (7.3:1). The Flames Lounge pillar icons (7.9:1 on lounge-deep) and menu category labels (7.7:1 on lounge-warm), written there as text-[#E0907F].

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Forest lifted for dark grounds (globals.css). Success, 'live' and 'done' text on ink (6.5:1). The SectionHeader eyebrow when `dark` is set (6.5:1 on ink). The right eyebrow colour on any dark ground in new work.

tokens.name: lounge-night
tokens.usage: Flames Lounge page only: the hero and the outdoor-studio band (bg-[#0A0806]). Darker than ink so the venue reads as night. The hero has no photo: it is this ground, a soft oxblood glow and a large flame mark at 14% opacity (hidden on phones). Text: bone (17:1), bone-50 (4.7:1), ochre (6.4:1); the hero lead in bone at 55% is at least 5.1:1, at the centre of the glow.
